name: Kanati Greycloud
summary: Kanati Greycloud is a tauren hunter stationed at Whitereach Post within Thousand Needles. Alongside his hunting companions, he musters what defense he can while enduring constant hostility from the local Galak centaur.

sections.title: A Precarious Perch
sections.body: Kanati Greycloud makes his camp at Whitereach Post, high atop the sandstone spires of western Thousand Needles. While the canyon offers abundant game and open vistas, it is hemmed in by the Galak centaur, whose warbands contest every inch of the arid flats below. Together with other tauren hunters, Kanati keeps watch over the canyon floor, striving to preserve the post against the brutal depredations of the surrounding marauders.

sections.title: Centaur Ambush
sections.body: The Galak centaur do not merely seek to isolate Whitereach Post; they intend to annihilate its defenders outright. Messengers sent between centaur camps carry explicit orders targeting Kanati and his companions for assassination. It falls to visiting travelers to intercept these marching orders and stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Kanati when the Galak raiding parties descend upon the mesa to cut down the outpost's hunters.

faq.answer: Kanati Greycloud is a tauren hunter based at Whitereach Post in western Thousand Needles, where he maintains a camp and defends against predatory local threats.

faq.q: Where can I find Kanati Greycloud?
faq.answer: Kanati is located at Whitereach Post, an elevated tauren encampment situated along the northern bluffs in the western portion of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why are the Galak centaur trying to kill him?
faq.answer: The Galak centaur seek total dominance over the canyons of Thousand Needles and actively target Horde outposts. Intercepted orders reveal a coordinated plot by the centaur to assassinate Kanati and break the post's defenses.

faq.q: Is Kanati related to other Greyclouds?
faq.answer: He shares his surname with Tor Greycloud and Kar Greycloud, two tauren found elsewhere in the Kalimdor wilderness, though the exact familial bond between them is not detailed.

angles.text: For tauren traversing Thousand Needles, aiding Kanati at Whitereach Post is a vital defense of tribal kin against their ancient, bitter enemies, the centaur.
Whitereach Post serves as a critical vantage point over the needle canyons; keeping Kanati alive ensures Horde scouts retain eyes on centaur troop movements.
